propositions: The anthropic cache breakpoint sits on the whole system block, so only byte-identical full system prompts share a cache entry; the Pass-2 verifier places the plan in the USER message and gains no plan-bearing cache benefit.

Introduce a single-sourced SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE and shared_plan_prefix(plan) in prompts.py so Pass-1 finder and both verifier system prompts share a byte-identical plan-bearing leading prefix, enabling provider-side prefix reuse.

Delete passes._SHARED_PREAMBLE and make _resolve_system plan-first for the finder, while non-restructured pass callers (container, ISF, completion, coach, novelty, contradiction, comment-trail) remain byte-equal modulo the added directive bullet.

Verifier templates lead with {{shared_prefix}} and drop {{plan}} plus the volatile marker, so the whole rendered template is the stable system prompt and the per-run finding listing stays user-turn as base_instructions/instructions.
plan_review_verify_inputs emits shared_prefix instead of plan, updating the output schema and both plan-review.yaml verify with: blocks; runs.py needs no change via generic string with:-merge.

Add an exhaustiveness directive bullet to the shared preamble reaching every Pass-1 entry point, and update the Pass-1 finder warm gate to measure the actual prefix via pass1._prefix_tokens against CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS (4096).
